meta.title: Tax Sale Investment Research
meta.disclaimer: Research aid only. A tax lien is not ownership of a property. No listing shown as a bundle without official current documentation. Value estimates require comps and a dated method. This independent research page is not an offer, charitable program, or use of charitable funds.
meta.imagePolicy: Property photographs must be licensed or supplied by authorized auction sources. Google Street View opens on Google Maps; Google imagery is not downloaded or rehosted.
meta.summary: One open, verified all-or-nothing tax-certificate offering (Lucas County OH) identified. Three October 2026 closed Michigan tax-foreclosure deed bundles retained as examples.

bundles.name: Lucas County 2026 — All-or-Nothing Tax Certificate Portfolio
bundles.parcelCountQualification: Preliminary schedule; final number may decrease
bundles.summary: County is offering its entire final eligible pool of delinquent real-property tax certificates to one buyer. 398 preliminary parcels; $3,640,138.24 delinquent balance as of Oct 23, 2026 (not the final minimum bid). Minimum offer is 100% of the final aggregate certificate purchase price plus required fees, and a premium bid may be included.
bundles.acquisitionDescription: One negotiated, all-or-nothing purchase of tax LIEN certificates, not deeds to the underlying properties. No partial-pool bids. All 398 preliminary parcels are in the county's official RFP schedule, but individual addresses were not independently imported because the linked PDF could not be extracted reliably.
bundles.risks: Large institutional-scale cash commitment. Full payment immediately available at closing; $300 administrative fee per initial certificate, certified-letter and recording costs; purchaser's proposed interest rate under Ohio law; foreclosure or redemption and delayed recovery; potential exclusions or redemptions can change pool, count and price. The county's updated parcel pricing schedule is due November 20. Review RFP eligibility, bidder documentation and legal counsel.
bundles.pricingNote: Historical tax delinquency balance only; not the full offer price, as of Oct 23.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 7965 · Saginaw 97-parcel bundle
archiveExamples.note: Actual tax-foreclosed deed parcels, grouped in one lot; $17,828.30 in current-year taxes and performance-bond conditions were also shown in the catalog. Closed 30 October 2026; not available at this minimum today.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8798 · Genesee vacant-lot bundle
archiveExamples.note: Vacant-lot deed bundle. Catalog title says 114 parcels, but detailed list enumerates 115; reconcile before any future offer. Current taxes shown $17,397.61. Closed 30 October 2026; advertised minimum no longer available.

archiveExamples.name: Lot 8799 · Genesee demolition bundle
archiveExamples.note: Tax-foreclosed property bundle with demolition and performance-bond requirements. Title says 198 but detailed list enumerates 199. Current-year taxes shown $182,849.97 in addition to minimum. Closed 30 October 2026; major liability and occupancy concerns.
